title: SvgForeignObject
responsibility: Renders the native foreignObject element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgForeignObject.attributes
inputs.description: Native foreignObject attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgForeignObject.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native foreignObject element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgForeignObject
outputs.description: The actual native foreignObject element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
